items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: He had Sonny Henry on the trombone... I was playing tenor banjo... that was his band.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band when you were there?
He had, um, he had Sonny Henry on the trombone. He had Camilla Tile. She's still living on the piano.
I've never met her. I've never met her. I've never met her.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Sonny Henry worked with uh with uh Hippolyte Charles' band with me

ctx.x: yeah this fellow's tall he's he's in those onion and brass bands did uh you ever work with Sonny Henry?

oh yeah Sonny Henry Sonny Henry worked with uh with uh Hippolyte Charles' band with me oh yeah yeah he used to call me G7 cause every time I'd be and they'd be there and sometimes I'd holler to the G7 and they'd call me G7
why was that? he would play on the wrong chord?
